signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Players with this ability will distract defenders for longer with their runoffs
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers
Defenders with this ability will clear a ballcarrier's progress towards entering the zone with a hit-stick tackle.
Players with this ability are harder to knock out of The Zone
Defenders with this ability do not need to spend a point on shed attempts during a run play
Passers with this ability receive better blocking support on designed quarterback run plays.
Passers with this ability have faster passing animations when they are throwing under pressure
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke animations.
Blockers with this ability will frequently attempt and win impact blocks against linebackers and defensive backs when playing as a lineman or fullback.
Blockers with this ability gain blocker resistance points as a faster rate
Blockers with this ability have an increased number of blocker resistance points
During preplay, players with this ability will highlight any oncoming blitzers on 3rd and 4th downs. Can be bluffed.
